newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Curve flattens again.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Curve flattens again.

text.p: The Australian bond yield curve remained under pressure as the short-end remained fragile on an unwinding of monetary policy easing expectations.

A Reuters poll of economists expectations taken today showed that chances of an official interest rate cut had dropped to 30 percent from 45 percent last week, and prior to Thursday's strong jobs numbers and cautious comments on wages by the RBA.
Yield spreads to the dollar bloc also widened as the local market squared up ahead of a barrage of U.S. data and a three-day holiday weekend for U.S. Presidents Day.
This data includes U.S. PPI for January.
The Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread was again testing 100 basis points at the close, a level that has proved supportive in the past week.
Canadian debt outshone the bloc due to continued optimism ahead of the Canadian federal budget.
